answers.questionRaw: PART 2 — PASSAGE COMPLETIONQuestions 13–17Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the option that best fits each numbered blank from 13 to 17. ONE WEEK TO GET BACK ON TRACK On Monday, Linh realised that she had three assignments due in the same week and basketball practice on two evenings. She usually kept deadlines in her head, but this time she was worried that she would forget something. (13) ______. After making the list, she marked the science report as her first priority because it was due on Wednesday. (14) ______. This meant that she could still go to practice without leaving everything until late at night. Her phone was another problem. Messages often interrupted her while she was working. (15) ______. She checked it only during her planned break. By Thursday, Linh had submitted the science report and finished most of another assignment. She was still busy, but she no longer felt that all the work had to be done at once. (16) ______. At the end of the week, she decided to keep using the one-page list during future busy weeks. She did not follow every plan perfectly, but the list helped her decide what needed attention first. (17) ______.Question 13.A. She cancelled basketball practice for the rest of the term.B. She wrote every task and due date on one page before deciding what to do first.C. Her teacher completed a schedule for her and sent it to her parents.D. She decided to begin with the assignment that had the latest due date.Write A, B, C, or D: {#1}Question 14.A. She saved the science report until after her two basketball practices.B. She planned to finish the whole report on Wednesday after school.C. She worked on other assignments first because they looked shorter.D. She divided the report into two shorter tasks and completed one each evening.Write A, B, C, or D: {#2}Question 15.A. So she left her phone in another room for thirty minutes at a time.B. She kept the phone beside her and replied whenever a message seemed important.C. She turned on message alerts so she would not miss any reply.D. She asked a friend to send her extra reminders while she was studying.Write A, B, C, or D: {#3}Question 16.A. She therefore added several new activities to her schedule.B. She decided that planning was making the week more difficult.C. Seeing her progress made the rest of the week feel more manageable.D. She stopped checking her assignment due dates after Wednesday.Write A, B, C, or D: {#4}Question 17.A. She decided that sports practice should always wait until all schoolwork was finished.B. She learned that a simple plan could help her manage several responsibilities more calmly.C. She concluded that the same timetable should be used during every busy week.D. She found that keeping deadlines in her head was enough once she had more work.Write A, B, C, or D: {#5}
